summary.key_theme: 市場焦點轉向 Cybercab 自動駕駛服務擴張與 AI 潛力，儘管存在合併 SpaceX 的監管疑慮與部分區域市場調整。

bullish.title: Tesla's Cybercab Reaches Dallas in November, and Nevada Just Cleared 5,000 Robotaxis in Las Vegas
bullish.reason: Cybercab 在德州與內華達州獲得監管許可並擴大部署，每英里 0.30 美元的營運目標被視為提升長期獲利能力的關鍵催化劑。

bullish.title: Tesla's robotaxi cash flow could bankroll SpaceX's AI ambitions: Ark Invest
bullish.reason: Ark Invest 指出 Robotaxi 的現金流潛力可支持 SpaceX 的 AI 發展，強化了 Tesla 生態系在 AI 領域的長期戰略價值。

bullish.title: Tesla Stock Could Rebound as These 3 Growth Drivers Take Center Stage
bullish.reason: 分析師指出 Tesla 的成長重心已從傳統汽車銷售轉向 AI、人形機器人與自動駕駛，為股價提供新的估值支撐。

bullish.title: If You Invest $1,000 in Tesla Today, Here’s What It Could Be Worth by 2030

bullish.title: See how Tesla stocks performed for week ending Oct. 30
bullish.reason: 股價在該週呈現上漲趨勢，反映市場情緒回暖。

bullish.title: Elon Musk Wants People to Sleep in Robotaxis, Police Department Says You Can Also Sober Up
bullish.reason: 警方對 Robotaxi 的正面應用建議提升了公眾對該技術安全性的信心。

bullish.title: Cybercab Expansion Might Change The Case For Investing In Tesla Stock
bullish.reason: 進一步確認 Cybercab 在多州擴張的進度，強化了自動駕駛服務作為未來核心營收來源的論點。

bearish.title: Tesla-SpaceX Merger Could Face The Biggest Regulatory Risk In China, BofA Warns
bearish.reason: 美銀警告若合併 SpaceX，Tesla 上海廠可能面臨中國監管機構的嚴格審查，對全球供應鏈構成重大不確定性。

bearish.title: SpaceX Is Considering a Merger With Tesla. Here's Why That Would Be a Bad Move.
bearish.reason: 市場分析認為合併兩家公司無法解決估值問題，反而可能導致資源分散與治理複雜化。

bearish.title: Why Is Tesla (TSLA) Reworking Cybertruck Plans And Battery Rules Now?
bearish.reason: Tesla 暫停澳洲與紐西蘭的 Cybertruck 預訂與銷售計畫，顯示國際市場擴張遭遇阻礙。

bearish.title: Tesla's Profits Took a Hit. Is It Building Something Worth the Cost?

bearish.title: Tesla and 113 other companies paid no current federal income tax
bearish.reason: 稅務報告指出公司未繳納聯邦所得稅，可能引發公眾與監管機構對稅務合規性的關注。

bearish.title: Elon Musk vs. Tesla? His Midterm Money Could Work Against His Own Cars
bearish.reason: 馬斯克的政治捐款與個人行為可能對品牌形象產生負面影響，進而影響部分消費者的購車意願。
